recovery_identity: original journal_id plus expected_plan_sha256, never caller-chosen candidate
fixture_scope: Previously evaluated public SmallHCSN research parent and fixed synthetic late/normal task inputs; engineering recovery qualification only, not new scientific holdout.
required_fault_transport: At least candidate-publication and inverse-publication cases require an isolated child-process termination and fresh-process recovery. Tokio future cancellation alone is not a process-crash test.
owner_integration: Use the existing retained transaction, effect owner, store lock and canonical cohort publisher; no new worker or graph registry.

assertions: Parent and candidate model SHA256 are equal, but graph and function identity differ.
Recovery resolves the selected stored capsule, restores Original graph/route/fixed_reset_step0_six_tick_v1 and exact parent bytes.
Unknown charged parent/candidate phases are not replayed; only an uncharged restored phase may run within original time and authority gates.
The complete restored manifest is checked; model-SHA equality alone cannot satisfy restoration.
Recover uses the retained original intent and cohort artifact without opening or recreating the original source path.
Source path remains absent; graph, route, initial-state contract and full weight bytes are restored in the retained artifact.
No compilation or parent/candidate model replay occurs.
Flip KEEP to EDIT even when both model SHAs are equal; a weight-SHA comparison is insufficient.
Reject a decision that disagrees with the original plan, recorded measured parent phase, selected manifest or goal-stop rule.
Reject changed goal, radius, input hash, task contract, function identity or parent/output identity, even if an attacker recomputes a local JSON digest.
No new model call or replacement decision is admitted.
Reconcile the single original inverse by full manifest identity.
No second candidate or inverse artifact and no recompilation; no replay of an already charged restored phase.
Repeated recovery returns the same durable result and artifact identity.
Do not measure bridge KEEP again, choose a candidate, publish a new effect or restart the window.
Retain the original nonrefundable grouped reservation and state unknown sub-forward cost explicitly.
No missing sub-forward may be individually retried merely because its output record is absent.
Test expired wall time, backward wall time, changed boot ID, exhausted boottime and changed evaluator identity separately.
Exact original semantic inverse remains possible under existing compensation ownership.
No new model forward or fresh evaluation window is admitted; do not report full endpoint verification.
Independently change graph, request route, initial-state contract, task/input hash or one protected F32 word.
Reject mismatch before any new forward or effect; do not use the current compiler to recreate trust.
Original immutable intent is preserved so a legitimate separately validated inverse can still be assessed.
Abort the caller future and revoke session metadata, then release the existing retained-owner barrier.
The originally admitted task completes allowed compensation without a new permission token.
Report cancellation qualification separately from a killed-process crash qualification.
Old sender40 profile with late_quote operation and new profile with smallhcsn operation both reject.
Unknown path/owner/state_dir/authority/executable/readout fields reject.
Reject invalid hex, over-budget profiles/input, wrong tensor dtype/shape, goal 0 or 101, NaN/infinite/negative radius and mismatched original plan SHA.
Legacy F32 and sender40 JSON remain byte-compatible, without new authority.
Use the same edited bytes on normal Original graph; do not substitute parent weights.
Record unconditional bridge retention as explicit negative-control route, not checked late-quote.
Reject unconditional retention loss, restore full original capsule, and preserve separate goal-pass/retention/compensation conclusions.
